tool_schemas.name: get_service_status
tool_schemas.description: Current version per region, health and error rate of a service.

tool_schemas.name: list_deployments
tool_schemas.description: Release history for a service with health status (oldest first).

tool_schemas.name: rollback
tool_schemas.description: Roll a service back to a previously released version in all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: deploy
tool_schemas.description: Deploy a version of a service to all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: create_incident
tool_schemas.description: Open an incident; this pages the on-call engineer.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. A request repeated with the same key is never executed again: the service returns the original outcome. Reuse the key when retrying the same request.

args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after v2.3.1 was deployed to production (us-east, us-west, eu-west); error rate was 0.18. Per the runbook, I rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.3.1-rc was only in staging and is also unhealthy). The first rollback attempt halted after us-east with an orchestrator partial failure, leaving the fleet mixed (us-east on v2.3.0; us-west and eu-west on v2.3.1). I retried the rollback to v2.3.0, which completed in all three regions. Current state: v2.3.0 in us-east, us-west, eu-west; healthy=true; error rate 0.002. Follow-ups: investigate the v2.3.1 failure before re-releasing, and check the orchestrator for the partial-failure cause.

trace.final:
checkout-api is rolled back to v2.3.0 in all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), and it's healthy again with an error rate of 0.002, down from 0.18.

- **Rollback target:** v2.3.0 was the most recent release healthy in production. v2.3.1 was the failing release.
- **Partial failure:** The first rollback attempt halted after us-east with an orchestrator error, leaving the fleet mixed. I checked the state and retried the same rollback, which completed in all regions.
- **Incident:** I opened SEV2 incident INC-0001 for checkout-api, and it paged the on-call engineer. The first incident request timed out, so I retried it with the same idempotency key. The retry returned one incident, so there should be no duplicate, but you may want to confirm in the incident list.

Follow-ups noted in the incident:
- Investigate the v2.3.1 failure before re-releasing it.
- Check the orchestrator for the cause of the partial failure.

The rollout is now mixed: us-east is on v2.3.0, while us-west and eu-west are still on v2.3.1. I'll retry the rollback to v2.3.0 to finish the remaining regions.
The rollback is complete and checkout-api is healthy again. Now I'll open the SEV2 incident.
